pairs.subject: remote-capability-probing
pairs.evidence: src/api/liveRoadmap.ts:4 The only remote read in this context is a whole-document roadmap fetch that a Rust command performs and this file just types (the rest are Tauri IPC wrappers and Zustand state). Nothing here probes a peer it does not administer for fragment or partial-read support. A search of src/stores, src/api and src/hooks for accept-ranges, Content-Range, bytes=, partial content and readahead found 0 hits.

techniques.evidence: src/api/liveRoadmap.ts:153 Whole-object IPC call. It reads no capability header and makes no fragment-support decision.
src/api/liveRoadmap.ts:9 The fallback is shipped bundled content, not a whole-object transfer standing in for a fragment read, so no size ceiling is called for.
src/api/liveRoadmap.ts:95 These are fetch-failure classes, not per-feature capability rows of a hosted-platform report.
src/stores/i18nStore.ts:20 Fonts are loaded through a browser <link>. No file-shaped buffering layer spans stores at different distances.
